periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation, approximately 45 degrees inward and downward toward the muzzle relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertical oval shape with an approximate 2:1 height-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering, extending significantly below the geometric center of the patch toward the lower facial region.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, broad U-shaped curve at the posterior margin of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, covering approximately one-third of the visible torso height on the lateral flanks.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap between pinnae, positioned at the extreme upper-lateral margins of the cranium.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellowish-brown discoloration observed on the ventral and abdominal fur relative to the white fur on the head.
